def solve(case):
    threshold = case['threshold']
    accepted_call_ids = []
    diagnostics = []
    for call in case['calls']:
        call_id = call['call_id']
        gain = call['loss_without_call'] - call['loss_with_call']
        normalized_gain = gain / call['prediction_tokens']
        accepted = call['parseable'] and normalized_gain >= threshold
        diagnostics.append({
            "accepted": accepted,
            "call_id": call_id,
            "normalized_gain": normalized_gain
        })
        if accepted:
            accepted_call_ids.append(call_id)
    return {"accepted_call_ids": accepted_call_ids, "diagnostics": diagnostics}
